breakdown.description: Flow is stated to be rotational, but Bernoulli is applied between different streamlines using a single constant; a uniform Bernoulli constant requires irrotational flow.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. It explicitly stated the flow is 'rotational' while still applying the Bernoulli equation between two points as if the constant were uniform. The ground truth correctly changes the flow to 'irrotational' to make the application of a single Bernoulli constant valid across the entire flow field.
